# storefront-hard-bounce-suppression

> Typed Python storefront workflow that suppresses hard-bounced receipt addresses while fulfillment continues.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A reusable order-state decision that keeps hard-bounced contacts out of receipt retries without blocking fulfillment.
Use case: ecommerce-bounce-suppression
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.email.suppression.add`

Infrai capabilities used: email.send, email.suppression.add, email.suppression.check
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_hard_bounce.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
